title: hedyotis horneriana
intro: Hedyotis horneriana, commonly known as Chinese hedyotis, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which may help reduce fever, relieve cough and sore throat, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis horneriana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
